verdict.rationale: LibreOffice is used as a headless conversion engine controlled through a CLI and the UNO API, so job-completion callbacks are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The UNO acceptor and macro execution are inbound control and developer building blocks, not webhooks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, finished jobs notify my system by callback instead of making me poll
